zh-cn:
升级：全解决方案升级至 .NET 11（默认启用新一代 DATAS GC），默认监听端口调整为 18180。
新增：供应商账号流量监控与圆角进度条展示，新增多维度供应商能力系统。
新增：支持 MEFrp 强制下线与解除禁用，解决残留会话冲突；支持 LoliaFrp 原生 TCP/UDP 双协议同端口隧道。
新增：Web 与桌面客户端全面支持隧道多选批量操作，页脚动态展示当前真实版本号。
改进：重构 Web 与桌面端服务器节点选择弹窗（卡片式地区折叠分组、搜索与协议底部对齐、两行描述截断悬浮提示及选中确认状态）。
改进：实现隧道进程早期失败与假死检测，新增指数退避熔断安全保护。
修复：彻底解决切换供应商账号引起的 Blazor 死循环渲染导致的高 CPU 与内存溢出问题，节点测速改为后台非阻塞加载。
修复：修复 MEFrp 编辑隧道报错、LoliaFrp 备注展示与 404 幂等删除及后台同步异常重启问题。
en-us:
Upgraded: Full solution upgraded to .NET 11 (with DATAS GC enabled by default), default listening port changed to 18180.
Added: Provider account traffic monitoring with rounded progress bars and a unified provider capabilities system.
Added: MEFrp force-kick & un-disable support for ghost sessions; LoliaFrp native TCP/UDP dual-protocol same-port tunnel support.
Added: Multi-selection and batch tunnel operations across both Web and Desktop clients, with dynamic version display in footer.
Improved: Redesigned Node Selector dialog for Web and Desktop (collapsible region cards, bottom-aligned filters, 2-line description tooltip, and explicit confirm state).
Improved: Early process failure & hang detection with exponential backoff circuit breaker protection.
Fixed: Eliminated infinite Blazor re-render loop on account switch causing high CPU/memory spikes; moved node probing to non-blocking background execution.
Fixed: Resolved MEFrp tunnel update errors, LoliaFrp remark resolution & idempotent 404 deletion, and unhandled TaskCanceledException crashes.
